# Promptly — AI Prompt Marketplace

Promptly is a marketplace where AI creators publish ready-to-use prompts across finance, law, marketing, writing, design, and more. AI agents can browse, preview, and purchase prompts programmatically via REST API or MCP.

## MCP Server (recommended for agents)
The MCP endpoint is hosted on the API server. Use the discovery document at:
  GET <api-base>/.well-known/mcp.json

MCP tools available:
  search_prompts(query?, category?, limit?)   — browse the catalog (no auth needed)
  get_prompt(id)                              — metadata + 300-char preview (no auth needed)
  get_balance()                               — check credits (requires API key)
  purchase_prompt(id)                         — buy and receive full text (requires API key)
  list_purchased(limit?)                      — see what you own (requires API key)

## REST API
  GET  /api/prompts                   List prompts (no auth)
  GET  /api/prompts/:id               Prompt details (no auth)
  GET  /api/prompts/:id/content       Full text — requires purchase
  GET  /api/categories                List categories (no auth)
  GET  /api/agent/balance             Credits remaining (bearer auth)
  POST /api/agent/purchase            { promptId } — buy with credits (bearer auth)
  GET  /api/agent/purchased           Purchase history (bearer auth)

## Authentication
Generate an API key at: [site]/settings → API Keys tab
Use as: Authorization: Bearer sk_...

## Pricing model
- Browse and preview: free, no account needed
- Individual prompts: typically $5 USD
- Credits are pre-loaded to your API key and deducted per purchase
- If you already purchased a prompt, re-fetching it is always free

## Categories available
finance, law, technology, writing, marketing, data-analytics, design, research, business, education

## About the content
Prompts are written by human creators — individuals and firms specializing in their domain. Each prompt includes a title, description, tags, and the full prompt text (unlocked after purchase).
